data.review_comment: Jim was an amazing host who I would recommend to anyone visiting Sedona. We thought the 7 hour wine tasting tour would be to long but it definitely wasn't. We enjoyed every minute of the tour.

I had the best time on my wine tour! I got to taste some great wines in the area and even found a nice bottle to take with me on my cruise! Ed was my guide and he was so knowledgeable of the area and so nice!

I booked SWA for a Girls Trip to Sedona, and it was the perfect afternoon activity.....everyone had a great time, and we were able to relax and truly enjoy Sedona wine country with our guides, Charles and Jake. They were flexible with the time schedule, and shared local info - on top of being friendly. I would definitely recommend for a group, or even a couple just looking for a no-stress experience!

We had an amazing day! Our wine guide, Jake, was fantastic. He tailored our experience to what we were up for and we were amazed at all that we saw and tasted. So much more than just drinking wine. I highly recommend that you book a tour if you are in the area!
For the price I expected more

I went on a Sedona Wine Adventure tour for my bachelorette party last August. It was a wonderful experience! George was our tour guide and he went above and beyond to ensure we all were having a great time. George was well educated, not only on wines, but on wines made in the area. We had 3 stops on our tour and each stop brought more and more delicious wine and food. I highly recommend Sedona Wine Adventures. But highly recommend even more having George as your guide! I will certainly be back!

We had such a great experience with Sedona Wine Adventures! We did the Vintage Tour, and everyone in our group was super happy with it! The flow of the tour was spot on, and all of the wineries we went to had unique and delicious selections of wine and great service. George was our guide and he did an amazing job! He knew all about the wines and a lot of history about the towns we stopped in. And lunch was sooo delicious! We went to Merkin Vineyards Tasting Room, and the gnocchi was some of the best I have ever had! I would highly recommend Sedona Wine Adventures!

This is a must do if you are visiting Sedona. Try to book with George. He was an amazing guide. He shared so much history and knowledge not just about the wine and wineries but the towns we visited. We booked the four stop package and one of the wineries was DA Ranch. They aren’t always open for tastings but if they are, make sure to check it out. Fabulous setting and delicious wines. Thank you Sedona Wine Adventures and especially George. We had a great time!

If you chose them at your first stop of the wine tour drink as much as you can on the first stop when you’re eating lunch. The two last stops you rarely have something to drink. We were picked up on time our driver was great, but was not what we really expected. We paid so much for so little and we were told that the last stop we would have someone pour wine and serve us different types of wine to taste and chose from the wines we tasted from in case we wanted to buy a bottle but instead we only had like 3 bottles and it was the 2 cups per bottle size which we were a group  of 6 people. I feel like we got ripped off. On top of that we had to wait almost an hour on the last stop to get the bottles. It was not coordinated at all. You only see one vineyard, the other 2 stops are restaurants. You are not able to walk around Jerome the driver not drives you around.
We paid about 2000 for 6 people but it was not worth it. We expected to see vineyards, we expected to taste more wines and for everything to be coordinated. At the vineyard there should have been a reservation made for us but there was not we arrived there at 3pm and we didn’t have drinks served until 4pm so we did not get to enjoy much of anything.
Alcantara is a beautiful location. The wine tasting was superb. Tour guides very friendly and knowledgeable.

Sedona Wine Adventures went above and beyond to accommodate our full group. Our guide (George) was extremely knowledgeable and passionate about wine and all the winery’s in/around town. The wine tour packages include everything, making it easy to relax and enjoy the adventure. 100% recommend booking with Sedona Wine Adventures and can’t wait for our next outing.

My mom, sister and I had the pleasure of having George as our tour guide. He picked us up at the house we were staying at 10 minutes before our tour start time. We went to three different places to taste a wide variety of Arizona wines and learned about winemaking in the state. George also took us to Jerome, a former mining town that now features many shops. He gave us a good history of the town and about some of the interesting people who used to live there. We had an opportunity to walk the main street in Jerome and visit a couple of shops. George had a great personality and a lot of patience! Thanks for a wonderful day and tour, George!

We spent the day with Aaron and Bruce. Aaron is very knowledgable about wine and wine making, and and both know the area - its history, geology and wildlife. They bring your attention to the most amazing insights of the Verde Valley and wine, of course. Tumbleweed Winery tasting room is a must see. If your looking for Arizona wines to taste, this company delivers.
We had a great experience with George. The wine was great. Jerome was awesome to see. We will be back with friends.

Highly suggest booking this tour if you are visiting Sedona! George and Christina were very professional and delivered great customer service. Nice car, delicious lunch, great wine tastings, and truly private!
This is the tour to take when visiting the Sedona area. Our tour guide, George, was extremely knowledgeable & personable and was flexible to our group’s tastes & schedule. Highly recommend!!!

We had a fantastic time with George! There were 4 of us with different wine tastes and he was able to make suggestions to accommodate each of our tastes. He was very knowledgeable, had great stories, and we had an all-around wonderful time!

This isn't your usual touristy wine tasting! Teri did a great job of curating our tastings to our personal wine preferences and shared a ton of knowledge about the area and Arizona wine. I highly recommend these tours for anyone visiting the Sedona area!

My day with Sedona Wine Adventures felt like a truly artistically curated, personalized experience. Jeff, our guide, was exuberant and full of great stories and knowledge about Arizona wine. It really opened my eyes to the wonder of the Verde Valley wine world. I loved it!
Fantastic day spent enjoying Ari za and the local vineyard/wine culture. Ed was a great guide b

I couldn’t be happier with my tour in Sedona! It truly exceeded all of my expectations.

Before the tour, I had prepared a list of places I wanted to see, and I honestly expected that we would only have time to visit a few of them. I was so pleasantly surprised when Jim told me we could cover everything I wanted — and in the end, we actually saw even more than I had planned!

What I appreciated most was how personalized the entire experience was. It never felt like a standard tour with a fixed itinerary. Jim constantly suggested interesting places, viewpoints, and little additions along the way, adapting the day to what I was interested in and making the experience even more special. We visited so many beautiful and fascinating places, including several that weren’t even on my original list.

Thanks to Jim, my first trip to Sedona became an unforgettable experience. I’m writing this review a few days after the tour, and I’m still incredibly impressed and filled with beautiful memories from that day.

The tour went far beyond what I expected, and Jim’s knowledge, flexibility, enthusiasm, and genuine desire to make the experience special made all the difference. I’m so grateful for this amazing day in Sedona and would absolutely recommend this tour to anyone who wants to truly experience this incredible place!

Juan was the best tour guide and was a big slay.
10/10 recommend
One of the best times in Sedona I have ever had
Juan was the best! We had the most fun wine tour and he had great suggestions 10/10!!!
Juan is the best guide, such a fun day!

Discovered Sip Sedona as a recommendation from our Airbnb hosts and it did not disappoint! From the first phone call with Dylan I knew it would be the right tour for my friends and I. We booked the tour for a Monday and ended up having a private experience with our tour guide Nathan! Since the tour ended up being private we were able to be flexible with our winery choices and ended up pivoting to explore Jerome, AZ as our second stop instead of a winery! Nathan was professional and personable and took lots of photos of us and shared some fun facts about Sedona! Highly recommend booking a tour with Sip Sedona!

We own DA Vines vineyard and recently contracted with Dylan to shuttle  our guests to and from the vineyard and parking. His beautiful van and smiling face was the perfect experience for our guests!  We could not have been happier with his service!  I will definitely use him next year and am confident recommending his service for any private event!! Dylan and Sip Sedona exceeded our expectations!

What a wonderful day of touring.  We asked Dylan if we could start at Caduceus in Jerome first and then we would rely on his advice for a brewery and additional winery stop.  He did not disappoint!  We tried beer at the Belfry Wood Fired Grill and Brewery in Cottonwood and then headed to Page Springs vineyards.  All supplied delicious food and drink and Dylan kept us entertained with stories, anecdotes and history during our drives to each stop.  We would highly recommend this tour and when we return, which we will, we will definitely request Dylan as our tour guide.
Wonderful experience with very knowledgeable and fun local guides. This is the best wine tour in the Verde Valley! Flexible and tailored to your group! 5+ Stars!!!!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
"My wife and I recently went on the Sip Sedona wine tour and had an amazing experience! Nathan was our guide, and he made the tour fun and informative by explaining everything so well. I highly recommend this tour for anyone looking to explore the beautiful wineries of Sedona. Cheers to a fantastic day of wine tasting!"

We had a great time with Sip Sedona with Nathan as our guide.  Nathan was prompt to pick us up.  He was a blast to have as a tour guide and to hang out for the afternoon.  We visited 3 great wineries while there and enjoyed all the wines at each place.  I've already recommended Sip Sedona/Nathan to a few friends going in the next few weeks.

We had the most amazing time on our tour. Dylan was such a great tour guide. He knows EVERYONE in the Sedona wine industry and they all love him. He was knowledgeable about the wine, the vineyards and the history of the area. We can’t wait to come back. This is a ‘must do’ when visiting Sedona!!  Cheers to Sip Sedona!!
We loved our wine tasting and tour with Sip Sedona! Highly recommend, especially if you have a large group.

Dylan is the man! We’ve had the pleasure of his company for 2 different tours over the past couple years. We had groups of 6 and 8 with his ride handling us very easily and could’ve fit many more. Very knowledgeable on the region and wines and obviously well respected by the vineyards. He’s just a good dude so it was kinda like a friend was running the  tour, not some snooty or annoyed driver forced to lug us around from place to place. Heck, I’ll just say it, he is now part of the family! See you soon buddy!

We thoroughly enjoyed our half-day wine tasting tour on New Years Day. Dylan is very knowledgeable about the local wines and has an excellent relationship with the staff members at the wineries we visited. We highly recommend his services. --Mike and Dana, Phoenix

Had a great 40th birthday wine tour with Sip Sedona. Nathan and Dylan were great drivers/hosts. Usually, when I am at a vineyard other tour companies care more about being on the clock and rushing their clients to the next spot, but Nathan and Dylan were more interested in ensuring we were enjoying ourselves and answered any questions we had about the winery and the verde valley region. They were also very flexible and accommodating. They listened to what we were interested in and tailored the tour to meet our needs. Book your next wine tour with Sip Sedona.
This was a fantastic and  personalized  experience. Dylan was able to teach us about the area while introducing us to AZ wine and beer. We truly enjoyed our afternoon.

My wife and I made last minute plans to go on a wine tour and Dylan went out of his way to make it happen for us! He clearly has a great reputation in the area and a deep knowledge of the wineries. We had such a wonderful time exploring new places around Sedona and look forward to coming back to see more. Sip Sedona should be your first choice when looking for a tour guide!
Dylan is an amazing tour guide who clearly knows his stuff when it comes to the wine of the Verde Valley. We got a tour of some of the area’s best vineyards and cellars. Highly recommended!

This really made my daughters wedding shower special to be able to have Dylan take us to a winery and pick us back up.
We plan on using the service again soon!
Very knowledgeable and a great guide to have take you around the area for wine tasting. 10/10

Great  guy. Knowledgeable and easy going.
Would recommend!
We have toured with Dylan multiple times. He is so knowledgeable but makes the experience so approachable. He is the best!

Dylan was great, we had a private group of 6. Communication and pick up from our Airbnb were great, we did the 4 hour with 3 wineries. He picked really cool locations, was super fun and even helped us get our photos as the day went on (and as we had more wine 😂). He went above and beyond to let us stay a bit longer at the wineries and kept us an extra hour longer so he could drop us straight at our dinner reservations. Wonderful experience and will definitely do again next time we are in Sedona!
Wonderful experience and a great day! Dylan is very knowledgeable about the area as well as the wine! I highly recommend this tour…we thoroughly enjoyed it!
We had a great wine tour with Dylan! He is very knowledgable and well connected in the Cottonwood Winery area. Thanks Dylan!

Dylan was great! Very knowledgeable on the wines and area! He picked amazing spots which made for some awesome pictures😊 We took four mothers on a tour for Mother’s Day and they, and everyone else, loved it!
Dylan was awesome! Enjoyed every minute of the tour. Thanks for a fantastic Mother’s Day, Dylan!

It was a pleasure spending the day with Dylan. He is very knowledgeable about the local vineyards and wine tastings. It was obvious that he is well known and respected by the local business people. Communication with Dylan before and after our trip to AZ helped us in planning the perfect vacation. Highly recommend choosing Sip Sedona for an amazingly customized tour.

So pleased we scheduled a wine-tasting tour with Sip Sedona. We had a great time exploring the local cities and visiting different tasting rooms. We learned lots of fun and interesting history from our host, Dylan, who clearly loves the rich region and local, growing wine scene. Thank you for a lovely day and a great experience.

We had a great time! Dylan was friendly and knowledgeable. He took our requests into account and we can’t believe we had such a personalized experience just for the two of us at such a good price. Highly recommended.

10 out of 10!!! We had a fabulous experience in Sedona & Jerome. Dylan with Sip Sedona was a fantastic guide and personalized our experience. Great communication, knowledge of the area and wine, and overall customer service. We will be back for sure!

My girl friend and I had a great day with Dylan on the winery tour! He was so helpful and accommodating, which made our experience easy & so enjoyable. We had so much fun, the day flew by. Would recommend, especially for a girls trip!

This was such a wonderful experience! Dylan is very knowledgeable about the local wines and places that he took us too! Lunch was an amazing restaurant with Italian cuisine that was the best I have ever had! It was a local experience and felt like we were part of the local crowd! He listened to what we liked and catered our trip to the places he took us to for our taste which was perfect!! Would recommend Sip Sedona to anyone wanting to experience the local wineries, breweries, or even cocktails if you are in the Sedona area!

Dylan is an excellent guide. He listened to our interests & made a few extra adjustments for us that fit our needs perfectly.
His choice of wineries was excellent & we enjoyed tasting some wonderful wines. The tasting room staff were knowledgeable & very friendly. They all knew Dylan well & clearly held him in high regard. We ended up purchasing 2 full cases of wine to bring home (thanks to Dylan for safely carrying them for us).
We both highly recommend Dylan as a knowledgeable winery guide, safe driver & for his friendly & welcoming manner. We're already looking forward to our next trip to Sedona.

We absolutely loved our tour with Dylan as our guide! We learned a lot about the vineyards, wines, and it was completely customizable based on your wine preferences. Everything was delicious. Our entire group was so happy to see a ghost town as well. We’ll definitely be coming back for a tour with Sip Sedona!

I called Sip Sedona and while they were totally booked for the weekend, Dylan was beyond helpful in finding me other options for wine tasting.  He is extremely knowledgeable about both Sedona and wine. Hopefully we can secure a tour with Sip soon!

We had a great time. Dylan did an awesome job at being available to provide wine recommendations and entertain us while also giving us space to enjoy time alone in the unique surroundings. Awesome host, and would definitely recommend!

Planned event with SipSedona for my husband’s 50th birthday with our friends. It was a wonderful day! Dylan was our guide, incredibly knowledgeable about wine, the local vineyards and had outstanding recommendations for us. What I was most appreciative of what how he tailored the day to our likes and what we were looking for. We visited 3 excellent wineries, had lovely snacks, and found some new favorites. He was a delight to book with, and everything was so smooth. If you are looking for a fun adventure for the day I would highly recommend this, and it doesn’t even have to be for a special occasion. We will definitely be using Sip Sedona again in the future.

We had such an incredible time touring various wineries with our amazing guide,  Dylan! Dylan was extremely knowledgeable about the area, it’s history, and of course all things wine! Prior to this trip I had no idea Arizona had such incredible wines. We truly enjoyed each of our stops and took plenty of wine home with us. Dylan offered us water and snacks and was a true gentleman. We highly recommend a tour with Dylan and Sip Sedona and we look forward to our next trip! Thanks so much Dylan!

We came across SipSedona online and that’s what encouraged us to venture to Sedona! We planned a full wine day with Dylan and it was absolutely fantastic! He took us to a number of amazing places and was so nice and easy to talk with. We highly recommend Sip Sedona to anyone even considering a wine trip!!

Dylan with Sip Sedona was fabulous!  He was so informative about the wine, the wine process and the history of each area we went to. He was very flexible and accommodating to make sure our day was fun and met all of our needs. We even stopped at a brewery.  You will not regret doing a tour with Sip Sedona!!

We booked a full day wine tour for our girls trip to Sedona and it was amazing! It was a great way to explore the area and experience a variety of wine tasting and brewery options. Dylan was very accommodating to our various taste buds and interests. We loved each and every unique venue.  Well worth the money! You won’t be disappointed!

Dylan was awesome!  So much knowledge and fun!  We did the 7 hour wine tour which I initially thought was going to be too long, but it was perfect!!!! Thank you Dylan for a memorable day for us ladies!🍷🥂
Dylan was a great host. He showed us a great time. We experienced places and vistas that we would not have found on our own.

What a great day we had with Dylan! Lunch and tasting at Merkin Vinyards, private tasting at Vino Zona, Chateau Tumbleweed, and ended our day at D.A. Ranch. Dylan was an excellent guide. Very knowledgeable. Love that he is local and involved in the community.

We did an awesome wine tour last September. A great afternoon activity with friends. Knowledgeable and friendly host. Beautiful variety of vineyards, tasting rooms, and historical information about the area! Enjoy!

We had the absolutely best day with Dylan. He took us all over the Verde Valley and we saw/experienced so many wonderful things. It was just about the perfect day. We will be back and cannot recommend Dylan and Sip Sedona enough!!
We highly recommend Sip Sedona! Dylan was great - very informative but also gave the group space when we wanted. Thanks again!

Amazing experience- not only did Dylan show us some amazing wineries, but his knowledge of the local area made the trip unforgettable. He showed us smaller towns outside of Sedona that were really cool, and the wineries he took us to had delicious wine and beautiful properties. Would highly recommend to anyone!

Dillon was amazing. His knowledge of the area and wines were perfect. He was known and liked  throughout the community. He put up with all our questions and tailored a tour for our needs. We are new to the area and needed his guidance. Good guy with personality. We would do again.

Fabulous wine tour personalized for us.  We were able to relax and the day he planned was perfect.  Great lunch, amazing wines, cool gallery, beautiful views and an essential deluxe climate-controlled SUV .
Dylan was great and loved his "surprise" places he took us too. And really knew the grape varieties and State vineyards.

I am a local here in Cottonwood. I have always been eager to try more of the local wines but didn’t know where to start. “Sip Sedona” was perfect for a fun day out with friends and wine tasting. Dylan was not only an amazing tour guide but has a wealth of knowledge about the Verde Valley and wine. He truly made our wine tasting experience up and above what I had expected. Thank you, Dylan! Happy wine tasting!

Highly Highly recommend using Sip Sedona for your wine tour!  Dylan was wonderful!  He was extremely knowledgeable about both the wine industry and the area.  My husband and I booked this as part of our anniversary trip. It was our first wine tour, so we didn't know exactly what to expect. We started off by going to a restaurant for lunch owned by a local vineyard to sample several wines. There Dylan was able to get an understanding of what type of wines my husband and I preferred.  Dylan then decided which other places we would visit.  Our second destination was a tasting room and distillery.  We were able to try another label and see how the process works.  Per our request, we then stopped at a brewery, then proceeded to a beautiful vineyard.  We were able to see different parts of Cottonwood, Jermone and Cornville during the tour. It turned out to be such a great experience and one of the highlights of our trip! Dylan was laid back and made the tour comfortable for us.  He even helped us locate the proper packaging so we safely transport our wine purchases on our flight home.  Do yourself a favor and book one of his tours!
We had a great time on our brewery and winery tour. It was exactly what we were hoping for and Dylan did a great time personalizing it to us!
We enjoyed our wine tour because of the laid back and casual way Dylan showed us around.  He was informative and interesting.

We had a very enjoyable day with Dylan as our host
Sipping our way through lunch - Wineries & a brewery too!  Dylan has lots of History of the area to share 🏜
So much fun~ definitely we will recommend to friends & family ~ Sip Sedona is a must!😁🍷

This was a very laid-back tour. Our adult children got us this for our 40th anniversary which was during the year of the pandemic. Plus a two day trip in Jerome. Dylan showed us so much that we’ve never seen in page Springs and in Cottonwood. We now have new places to go.  Dylan was very knowledgeable about everything and gave us a lot of insight into Arizona wineries and some really nice places we went to. If we hadn’t had him we wouldn’t of known that these places existed. And we did have some really awesome wines. I’m not sure we would do a personalized wine tour again but now we have a little more knowledge about where to go.

We had a great time on this wine tour.  Dylan was extremely knowledgeable and it made for a fun day.  He took care of everything, once he had picked us up, until he had dropped us off.  Outstanding day

My wife and I had an absolutely wonderful time with Dylan as he showed us around Verde Valley. Informative and fun! We had a blast. The pacing, the stories shared, the wineries visited, it was all wonderful. Definitely a great tour for first-time visitors to Verde Valley like my wife and I were, although I can easily see how Dylan can still engage with more-seasoned visitors to the area. We know we only scratched the surface with this first visit, and we loved it.
Dylan was awesome! Highly recommend Sip Sedona!!

Took a trip around Page Springs for my bachelorette party with Sip Sedona and had the greatest day! Dylan was super accommodating and made sure we had everything we needed the entire time! He knew all the best spots and provided a comfortable, fun experience!

We did a wine tour for my sister’s bachelorette, and it was such a fun experience! Dylan was an awesome guide and took great care of us, he even provided snacks in the van and got us the best seats in the house at each location we stopped at. Sip Sedona is highly recommended!

Dylan was fantastic! This was our first trip to the Arizona wine country and taking this tour made the trip. It was individualized to what we were looking for and gave us so much great info about the different areas to see and visit as well as introduced us to some amazing new wines! We highly recommend this tour and we will be coming back with my parents to do it again.

We had a fantastic day with Dylan touring the Sedona/Cottonwood/Jerome area, learning interesting history and tasting wines that were delicious and unique. Dylan knows the area well and has great local contacts. We started with a fabulous lunch and flight of wine at a great restaurant in Cottonwood, moved on to a tasting room in Jerome with exclusive offerings (literally not available elsewhere) and completed the tour with two more stops at lovely vineyards. Dylan was so accommodating - we literally called him two days before we hoped to do the tour and, though his week was booked, he offered to move his schedule around to make it happen for us. Similarly, the fabulous owner of the tasting room in Jerome usually is not open for business on Wednesdays but graciously opened her shop when Dylan let her know that he'd like to bring us by. Highly recommend Sip Sedona if you are in the area looking for a wine tour!

Had an amazing day with Dillon. Learned some cool new stuff about the area, drank some fantastic wine and had some bomb burritos! Would highly recommend this experience - such a fun way to see some really cool spots. Can’t wait to do it again!
Dylan went above and beyond and made our wine tour so very interesting and enjoyable.  We were on a girls trip and we’re not aware of such great wineries in AZ!  So glad we found his tour service!!

Our time with Sip Sedona was a blast!  Dylan is a great guy, and so knowledgeable about wine and the Verde Valley.  We loved that he was able to personalize our tour to our preferences and got to learn about the Sedona/Jerome/Cottonwood area while traveling around.  He was even kind enough to drop us off at our dinner spot and helped us make arrangements for a cab to get us back home later on.  I would highly recommend Dylan and Sip Sedona for a wonderful and personalized tour experience!

Dylan was fabulous! We booked a day trip and he took us to 4 or 5 wineries, and it was just what we were looking for. We were able to relax, enjoy good wine & food, the company and safely get around town. His recommendations were spot on and we would definitely go back!

First off, Dylan is extremely knowledgeable when it comes to wine. He was able to understand our wine preferences after one or two stops. Our stops felt extremely personal because of Dylan’s relationships with the owners and/or sommelier’s we dealt with. He was able to make us feel right at home. In between stops is when he shared his knowledge on wine and on the surrounding area. Dylan is also very socially aware and knows when to let our group talk within ourselves and when to be apart of our conversations. Would come back to the Sedona/Jerome/Cottonwood area strictly because of his services.

Dylan is so knowledgeable about the local wines and area, it was so informative in a fun relaxed way! Highly recommend Sip Sedona for your wine adventures in the Verde Valley! Can’t wait to book my next tour!
We had a great day!  Dylan was very knowledgeable and accommodating.  We would highly recommend spending the day with SipSedona!

Dylan customized our tour to fit our needs and desires. Our group had to be completely gluten free and he picked the best place for lunch! We asked him to take us to places with a view and we were not disappointed. I will say, we had a tour from 11-5:30 and ate at the beginning, I also wish we had gotten a large snack or a second meal around 2 or 3pm because that was a long time to go without food (or I should’ve brought a snack). But seriously, if you enjoy wine and are looking for a leisurely way to enjoy yourself, book a tour. You won’t be disappointed!
What a great wine tasting experience! Can’t imagine a more personalized and professional tour.

Dylan is a very experienced and knowledgeable wine tour guide.  His tour was fun, made us feel at ease, and enjoyable.  We highly recommend SIP Sedona to anyone looking to sample the many different wines from this region.

Awesome time with Dylan touring local wineries in Sedona/Cottonwood area.  Tour was customized for our needs and wants.
A great afternoon with friends.  Thank you Dylan for your knowledge and expertise in wine.

Dylan was great.   It was our 50th anniversary and was gotten for us from our daughters.  We had a great time going to the different places and the tour at Page Springs Cellars was so informative.  Dylan was very nice and accommodating to what we wanted to do and see.  Very pleasant during the whole day and lots of good conversation.   I would recommend Sip Sedona.

Dylan is a great guy and a family man who knows how to turn a normal tour into an experience to be remembered. I appreciate his knowledge to the verde valley and not only wine and beer, but coffee and history as well. I would recommend you book your tour of the Sedona red rock areas wineries with him.
